units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 4:1">Succ. IV, 1</cite> <he>נ׳ המים שבעה</he> the water libation (on the Succoth festival) is continued for seven days. Y. ib. 54ᵈ top; Tosef. ib. III, 15 <he>נִיסּוּכוֹ בקדושה</he> at its libation the laws of sanctity must be observed; (<cite ref="Tosefta Meilah 1:16">Tosef. Meïl. I, 16</cite> <he>נְסִיכָתוֹ</he>).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 62a:18">Snh. 62ᵃ</cite> <he>נ׳</he> libation to idols; a. fr.—Pl. <he>נִיסּוּכִים</he>, <he>נִיסּוּכִין</he>, <cite ref="N00703"><he>נִסּ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 78">Gen. R. s. 78</cite>, end <he>כמה נ׳ ניסך יעקב</he> how many libations Jacob performed.
<cite ref="Taanit 2b:16">Taan. 2ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>שני נ׳</he> two kinds of libations.

senses.gloss: the manipulation by an idolater by which he causes wine to be forbidden to Jews as יֵין נֶסֶךְ (v. נָסַךְ).
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 56b:4">Ab. Zar. 56ᵇ</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <he>נ׳ דרגל … נ׳</he> operating with the foot is not called a ritual manipulation (does not affect the wine); a. e.
